mapper.sql: select consumption_id, electric_device_id, electric_device_code, recording_time, value, consumption_value, electricity_price, electric_charge, version, is_deleted, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, attr1, attr2, attr3 from ecm_electricity_consumption
mapper.select: WHERE electric_device_code = #{electricDeviceCode} AND create_time =DATE_FORMAT(#{date}, '%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00') order by recording_time desc LIMIT 1

SELECT eed.electric_device_code as electricDeviceCode, eed.electric_device_name as electricDeviceName, eed.is_main as idMain, SUM(consumption_value) AS totalUsage FROM ecm_electricity_consumption eec JOIN ecm_electric_device eed on eec.electric_device_code = eed.electric_device_code WHERE recording_time BETWEEN #{beginTime} AND #{endTime} and is_main = '1' GROUP BY electricDeviceCode

select location, sum(totalUsage) as totalUsage from (SELECT eed.electric_device_code as electricDeviceCode,eed.location, SUM(consumption_value) AS totalUsage FROM ecm_electricity_consumption eec JOIN ecm_electric_device eed on eec.electric_device_code = eed.electric_device_code WHERE recording_time BETWEEN #{beginTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY location,electricDeviceCode)as t group by location

SELECT workshopType, SUM(totalUsage) as electricQuantity from ( SELECT CASE WHEN location = '小拉车间' THEN '小拉车间' WHEN location = '中拉车间' THEN '中拉车间' WHEN location = '微拉车间' THEN '微拉车间' WHEN location = '镀锡车间' THEN '镀锡车间' WHEN location = '总柜' THEN '总柜' END AS workshopType, eed.electric_device_code as electricDeviceCode, SUM(consumption_value) AS totalUsage FROM ecm_electricity_consumption eec JOIN ecm_electric_device eed on eec.electric_device_code = eed.electric_device_code WHERE YEAR(recording_time) = YEAR(CURDATE()) and is_main = '0' GROUP BY workshopType,electricDeviceCode) as t GROUP BY workshopType

SELECT workshopType, SUM(totalUsage) as electricQuantity from ( SELECT CASE WHEN location = '小拉车间' THEN '小拉车间' WHEN location = '中拉车间' THEN '中拉车间' WHEN location = '微拉车间' THEN '微拉车间' WHEN location = '镀锡车间' THEN '镀锡车间' WHEN location = '总柜' THEN '总柜' END AS workshopType, eed.electric_device_code as electricDeviceCode, SUM(consumption_value) AS totalUsage FROM ecm_electricity_consumption eec JOIN ecm_electric_device eed on eec.electric_device_code = eed.electric_device_code WHERE YEAR(recording_time) = YEAR(CURDATE()) -- 当前年份 AND MONTH(recording_time) = MONTH(CURDATE()) -- 当前月份 AND is_main = '0' GROUP BY workshopType,electricDeviceCode) as t GROUP BY workshopType

SELECT CASE WHEN location = '小拉车间' THEN '小拉车间' WHEN location = '中拉车间' THEN '中拉车间' WHEN location = '微拉车间' THEN '微拉车间' WHEN location = '镀锡车间' THEN '镀锡车间' WHEN location = '总柜' THEN '总柜' END AS workshoptype, CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(recording_time) = 2 THEN '周一' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(recording_time) = 3 THEN '周二' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(recording_time) = 4 THEN '周三' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(recording_time) = 5 THEN '周四' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(recording_time) = 6 THEN '周五' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(recording_time) = 7 THEN '周六' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(recording_time) = 1 THEN '周日' END AS week, DATE(recording_time) AS record_day, SUM(consumption_value) AS totalUsage FROM ecm_electricity_consumption eec JOIN ecm_electric_device eed ON eec.electric_device_code = eed.electric_device_code WHERE DATE(recording_time) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) -- 过去 7 天数据 AND recording_time <= NOW() AND is_main = '0' GROUP BY workshoptype, week, record_day ORDER BY workshoptype, record_day;
